personalInfo.name: PRAMUDITHA NADUN
personalInfo.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
personalInfo.intro: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience at LOLC Technologies, building enterprise web applications for the Fusion X lending and core banking platform. Full stack developer specialising in React, TypeScript and Spring Boot, with hands-on experience in REST APIs, permissions and access control, CI/CD pipelines, Docker and UI/UX design in Figma. Also builds distributed asynchronous systems and machine learning forecasting models. Works in Agile/Scrum teams and focuses on secure, scalable, user-centric solutions.

description: Develop and maintain enterprise-scale web applications using React and TypeScript, with Redux for state management and Ant Design for responsive UI components.
Architect and optimise backend functionality in Spring Boot, ensuring efficient data processing, secure user access control and precise screen-level permissions.
Manage and monitor CI/CD pipelines through Jenkins and ArgoCD to streamline deployments across QA, UAT and Production environments.
Bridge engineering and design by conceptualising and refining interfaces in Figma, improving overall usability.
Maintained and developed backend processes and reporting systems using Java and Oracle Forms.
Designed and generated complex, data-driven dashboards using Jasper Reports to facilitate high-level business decision-making.
Engineered and developed interactive frontend components and responsive layouts, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into functional software solutions.
Developed data-driven reports and investigated, identified, and fixed application bugs and defects across enterprise modules to improve system stability.

projects.title: Fusion X Core Banking System
projects.tech: React, TypeScript, Redux, Spring Boot, Java
description: Built React forms and form schemas for core banking workflows, and handled core banking business logic across the application.
Implemented REST APIs and managed user permissions and access control at screen and feature level.
Maintained UI design standards and held ownership of frontend modules across the Fusion X platform.

projects.title: 11LabsM - Neural Voice Synthesizer & Translator
description: Architected a distributed full-stack platform that translates and synthesises speech into 17+ languages using the ElevenLabs, DeepL and Google APIs.
Orchestrated asynchronous background processing for text-to-speech workloads using Redis, giving users real-time progress tracking.
Implemented SHA-256 content-addressed caching to reduce external API costs and response latency.
Containerised the API, workers, cache and database with Docker Compose for streamlined deployment.

description: Built a React platform for detecting and monitoring fraudulent financial transactions, with secure API integration and real-time data visualisation.
Managed complex workflows with Redux and Context API and delivered responsive dashboards with actionable fraud-prevention insights.

projects.title: Brent Crude Oil Forecasting System
projects.tech: Python, XGBoost, GRU, ARIMA, VMD, FinBERT
description: Engineered a leakage-free ensemble machine learning model for a 5-day crude oil price prediction horizon.
Applied Variational Mode Decomposition to analyse non-linear frequency signals, and FinBERT sentiment analysis using strictly event-driven, lagged news data.
